question: What heroic attributes characterize the figure invoked in this mantra line?
premises: The figure destroys the darkness of wicked warriors.
The figure is described as a sun born of Reṇukā.
inference: The invoked figure is portrayed as a radiant destroyer of wicked warriors and son of Reṇukā.
plain_english: He is the destroyer of the darkness of wicked warriors, the sun born of Reṇukā.
